## Download progress that tells the truth
- The download button on a playlist (the arrow next to Share) no longer jumps to a full bar the moment you tap it. The bar now starts empty and fills exactly as far as the download really is: songs finished plus how far the song coming in right now is, so it grows steadily from 0 to 100 %
- Hovering (PC) shows "Downloading 12/69", the same count the settings page shows
- The preload button (lightning) uses the same calm bar

## New: Download to server
- Imported playlists (Spotify and others) have a new entry in the … menu: **Download to server**
- The server fetches every song that only streams once and keeps it in its own library (folder `Streyn` in the upload folder), with title, artist, album and cover
- Those songs then count as local: the "X of Y local" line counts along live while it runs, and they play without YouTube from then on
- A small bar at the top shows "To server: 12 of 69" with real progress; you can leave the page, it carries on and picks up again when you come back
- The download button that saves the playlist on this device stays as it was
- Same on PC, phone and web

## Install
- **Update server:** Settings → Updates → Update now (or run the Proxmox script)
- **Android:** Settings → Updates → Update now
- **Windows:** Settings → Updates, or run the new installer
- **Linux:** Settings → Updates
